title: CICaDo Workflow Schema v1
description: Schema for CICaDo workflow files. Deliberately constrained: no loops, no expressions beyond `if: success|failure|always`, no templating language. Logic belongs in scripts and containers.

name.description: Human-readable workflow name. Must be non-empty and unique within a repository.

on.description: Event triggers that activate this workflow. At least one of push, pull_request, or schedule must be set.

branches.description: Glob patterns matching branch names. Empty or absent means all branches. Supports *, **, ? (gitignore rules).

paths.description: Pathspecs (git pathspec syntax). Empty or absent means all paths.

types.description: Event types to handle. Empty means all types.

schedule.description: Fire on a cron schedule (5-field, UTC).

cron.description: List of standard 5-field cron expressions in UTC. Multiple entries are OR'd.

jobs.description: Map of job-name to job specification. At least one job is required. Job names are unique within the workflow.

additionalProperties.description: A single job within the workflow.

runs-on.description: Labels/tags a runner must carry. All must be present on the runner (required_tags <@ runner.labels).

needs.description: Names of upstream jobs that must all succeed before this job runs. A single string or a list of strings. Must not reference this job (no self-edges).

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to execute. At least one step is required.

items.description: A single step. Exactly one of `uses` or `run` must be set.

uses.description: Built-in step name (e.g. 'checkout') or a fully-qualified package reference. Mutually exclusive with `run`.

run.description: Shell command executed by the runner. Mutually exclusive with `uses`.

image.description: Container image for this step. Empty means use the job-level image. Should be digest-pinned where possible.

identity.description: Cloud identity this step runs with. 'none' or '' is default. 'aws' uses OIDC AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity.

env.description: Per-step environment overrides merged on top of job-level env. Secret refs use the format 'secrets.NAME'.

if.description: When this step runs conditionally. Default is 'success' (all prior steps succeeded).

timeout.description: Wall-clock budget for this step in seconds. 0 means use the job or server default.

network.description: When true, opt the step into outbound network access. Default is false (docker uses --network none).

approval.description: A human-approval gate. When set, the job waits until a human on the allow-list approves it before running.

channel.description: Chat channel or DM to post the approval request to (e.g. '#deploys').

allow.description: Principals permitted to approve. Format: 'kind:name'. Known kinds: 'user', 'team', 'group'. Example: ['user:@alice', 'team:platform'].

timeout.description: How long (seconds) to wait for approval before auto-failing the gate. 0 means wait indefinitely.

image.description: Job-level default image for all steps. A step's own image field overrides this.

env.description: Environment map applied to every step in this job. A step's own env takes precedence.

timeout.description: Total wall-clock budget for the entire job (all steps) in seconds. 0 means no explicit timeout.
